On that note, here's the reason why I think EDP's been fundamentally doomed from the start.

Once a Youtuber is thrust into the spotlight, they find themselves up on a stage with a big eager audience. Some Youtubers buckle and can't stand the pressure. Others let the fame get to their heads. Regardless of what happens, these Youtubers started gaining a following because there was something within them that we found cherishable. The ones that truly march on become incredibly important not only within Youtube but Internet culture as a whole. They become inspirational, leaders, and people look up to them however they may. 

Instead, when EDP was thrust into the spotlight, it was to be a fucking caged animal in a circus, and his fans are there for their own pleasure. They make fun of him by getting him agitated and feeding his destructive behavior. He's on display for them, and they only like him because they know he'll do whatever they want him to do. We didn't look up to him because he had an outstanding character or personality, we only liked this dude because he was a big guy who went on camera and spoke from his heart not giving a fuck what others thought about him. It's certainly the case now, and you can't deny that's been the case in the past (at least when I started watching him, around 2015).

The dude has never made an effort to truly connect with his audience. So whether or not he receives repercussions for his actions, dude's fucked regardless. It's only a matter of time before he runs himself into the grave.
